declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty. The declaration changes remote GitHub configuration of lutzseverino/site through its canonical-labels and pull-request-integration fixes and only reads the optional .github/pull-request-reviewer.json and .github/factory-review-policy.json, so it covers no project-content paths. Repository identity: the only Git remote, origin, is https://github.com/lutzseverino/site; `gh repo view` resolves lutzseverino/site, visibility PUBLIC, viewer permission ADMIN through the authenticated account lutzseverino (checked 2026-11-02). Remote configuration is authorized: the owner approved this adoption follow-up and its merge on lutzseverino/site#1 (https://github.com/lutzseverino/site/pull/1#issuecomment-6567277613, 2026-11-02), and the adoption guide lets the run apply its GitHub remote setup fixes (labels, pull request integration) on the owner's account. REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON: `gh variable list` returns no repository-level variables, so it is absent and classifies as unset (hosted default). The owner lutzseverino is a User account, not an organization, so no organization-level variable can supply a value; no uncertainty remains about an inherited value. Neither .github/pull-request-reviewer.json nor .github/factory-review-policy.json exists, and both stay untouched.

Intentionally empty. The repository tree at the adoption base (initial commit 'chore: start the repository') holds no files besides Git metadata: no manifest such as package.json, no workspace or build configuration, no maintained source, no documentation and no component boundary, so it contains no Project under rules/project-readmes.md and no non-root README.md path is proposed. The root README.md belongs to repository-readme. The planned personal website has no code yet; a Project README joins this scope when its Project exists.

Drafted from manifests and workspace configuration by `discovery/draft-typescript-astro-stack-scope.mjs`: one `package.json` per Project, included when it matches the stack's manifest facts and excluded naming its differences otherwise. A maintained workspace root package is a Project alongside its members; a shared-only root is not. Uncertain root membership stays unresolved. A root package without workspace members is a Project. The repository holds no matching web Project, so the declaration has no scope.
